Appendix C (p.597): Eq. (3) coefficient (m-k)/m should be (m-k+1)/m; the 3.7% single-shard case should be about 11.1% (1/9); 1.56x matches 4 UTXOs, not the 3 stated

Throughput at 1,800 hosts, 12.5% adversary: Introduction (p.584) says 6,000 tps, Section VIII-B (p.593) says 13,000 tps in 25 shards; Fig. 6 (p.592) bar [70, 12.5%] reads about 6,800 tps regular and 19,900 tps trust-but-verify from PDF vector coordinates (log axis 10^0 at y=186.21, 10^7 at y=76.2; Visa line reads about 4,120 as a calibration check)
Section VIII-B (p.593) says final confirmation of high-risk transactions takes less than one minute; Table I (p.592) shows 62.96 s at [600, 25%]
Table IV (p.595) lists OmniLedger scale-out as 2,400 validators; the reported experiments stop at 1,800 hosts
25% adversary at Visa-level throughput (about 4,200 hosts, 7 shards) is an estimate only (p.593); the [600, 25%] setting itself was measured at 1,800 hosts (Fig. 6, Table I)
Table II (p.593): 12.5% adversary, shard size 70; the cross-shard share of the workload is not reported
